 Newcastle vs Everton betting tips
 Draw - 13/5 Coral 
 Barry over 1.5 shots on target - 29/10 Unibet 
 Newcastle and Everton meet for the second time in just four days tonight, but this time at St James’ Park in the Premier League (8pm, Sky Sports Main Event).
 The two sides met at the Hill Dickinson Stadium on Thursday in the League Cup, and it was the Toffees who secured their place in the quarter-finals of the competition with an impressive 3-1 win. 
 Goals from James Garner and Hayden Hackney gave David Moyes’ side a 2-0 lead at the break, and Thierno Barry made it 3-0 after 69 minutes. Defender Dan Burn did pull a goal back for the visitors, but they went on to suffer their fourth defeat in their last six matches. 
 In the league, the two sides are separated by just two places and one point, with Newcastle having picked up 11 points to Everton’s 10, so it’s not really a surprise that the home side are the favourites on betting sites tonight.

 Newcastle vs Everton betting preview: Magpies to be much improved
 Matthias Jaissle’s side have lost just once at home this season, against Aston Villa a fortnight ago, when Johan Manzambi scored the only goal of the game, midway through the first half. 
 They have won two and drawn the other two, accounting for just over 66 per cent of all of their points so far this season.
 Everton, on the other hand, have lost just once away from home this season and that came at the Emirates Stadium a week ago, when they went down 2-0 to Arsenal. 
 They have drawn their other three away league games against Bournemouth, Tottenham and Hull City.
 The two sides have met 62 times in the Premier League, and their head-to-head couldn’t be much closer, with Everton having the slight edge with 25 wins to Newcastle’s 24, while there have been 13 draws, although the points have only been shared twice in the last 12 matches.
 Including Thursday’s win, Moyes’ side have won three of their last four meetings, including their last two trips to St James’ Park.
 They won 3-2 there last season, thanks to goals from Jarrad Branthwaite, Beto and Barry, which was payback for their 4-1 drubbing at home three months earlier. 
 The home side have scored 12 and conceded 14, while Everton have scored eight and conceded nine, so both sides to score is a good option.
 BTTS is 8/13 on some football betting sites and you can get 9/5 on over 3.5 goals being scored, which has happened in their last three meetings.
 Newcastle will be desperate to perform better than they did on Thursday, but Everton will be buoyed by that performance and given how well they’ve performed away from home recently, can take something from tonight’s game. 
 Newcastle vs Everton prediction 1: Draw - 13/5 Coral 
 Barry to provide the biggest threat for the visitors
 Everton striker Thierno Barry sits second to only Erling Haaland in the expected goals stats so far this season with an xG of 5.08.
 The Frenchman has seven goals in all competitions so far, but only three have come in the Premier League, against Crystal Palace, Ipswich Town and Hull.
 He averages two shots on target per game, and he’s 29/10 on some online betting apps to record over 1.5 shots on target tonight, and the same on him scoring at any time.
